summary: execute() returns a receipt for unreapable and abandoned children instead of raising TimeoutExpired. Both new paths set completionAmbiguous true and verified false. Abandoned children record cleanupOwner pid and pgid.

findings.summary: proc.wait(timeout=5) TimeoutExpired no longer escapes execute(). The receipt is recorded. Unobserved exitCode is None.
A missed first reap issues a second SIGKILL and a second 5-second wait. A still-unreaped child is recorded as abandoned with cleanupOwner.

newReceiptFields.verified: boolean. False on both new paths. True only when a behavioural assertion is observed.
newReceiptFields.abandoned: boolean. True only when both reap bounds miss.
newReceiptFields.cleanupOwner: object {pid, pgid} when abandoned, else None. Unobserved pgid is None, never 0.

tests.test_unreapable_wait_keeps_reservation_u: First wait times out. Second wait returns -9. Reservation stays active. Two SIGKILL calls. abandoned false. completionAmbiguous true. verified false.
tests.test_abandoned_child_keeps_reservation_u: Both waits time out. Reservation stays active. abandoned true. exitCode null. cleanupOwner.pid 4242. completionAmbiguous true. verified false.
